template: truncate(ts_decay_linear(group_normalize(if_else(and(greater(group_rank(vec_skewness({version}), industry), 0.8), greater(group_rank(vec_kurtosis({version}), industry), 0.7)), 1.2, if_else(and(less(group_rank(vec_skewness({version}), industry), 0.2), less(group_rank(vec_kurtosis({version}), industry), 0.3)), -1.2, 0)), industry), 3), maxPercent=0.02)
idea: 峰度确认的偏度极化策略：引入vec_kurtosis作为确认信号，仅当偏度和峰度同时处于行业极端区间(如高偏度伴随高峰度)时才建立多头或空头头寸，过滤掉单一指标虚假极值；最后使用truncate限制个股最大权重不超过2%，防止因向量数据异常导致的单票过度集中风险，配合3日线性衰减平滑调仓。
expression_list: truncate(ts_decay_linear(group_normalize(if_else(and(greater(group_rank(vec_skewness(anl85_version), industry), 0.8), greater(group_rank(vec_kurtosis(anl85_version), industry), 0.7)), 1.2, if_else(and(less(group_rank(vec_skewness(anl85_version), industry), 0.2), less(group_rank(vec_kurtosis(anl85_version), industry), 0.3)), -1.2, 0)), industry), 3), maxPercent=0.02)
